text.id: Malem. Angin mulai bunyi di seng-seng atap. Jendela kamar Sekar getar tiap kali ada yang lebih kenceng.
text.en: Night. The wind has started to rattle the tin roofs. The window of Sekar's room shakes every time a gust comes through.

text.id: Bentang yang lapor Pak Hendra nyulik? Mereka yang ngancem kita, terus mereka yang lapor?
text.en: Bentang reported Pak Hendra for kidnapping? They're the ones threatening us, and they're the ones reporting?

text.id: Kalau polisi yang dateng ke Pari, Sekar nggak bisa nolak ikut. Dan kalau orang Bentang ikut, alat rekamnya...
text.en: If it's the police who come to Pari, Sekar can't refuse to go with them. And if Bentang's people are with them, her recorder...
We have to get there first.

text.id: HP gue bunyi. Nomor yang nggak gue simpen. Suara di seberang berat, pendek-pendek, ditutupin angin.
text.en: My phone rings. A number I haven't saved. The voice on the other end is heavy, clipped, half drowned by the wind.

text.id: Besok angin besar. Syahbandar pasti nutup laut. Siang ada reda sebentar. Saya jalan pas reda. Satu kali, nggak nunggu.
text.en: Big wind tomorrow. The harbor master will close the sea. There's a lull around midday. I go in the lull. Once, no waiting.

text.id: Yanti cerita kamu duduk lima menit nungguin abang saya ngomong. Besok siang ada reda sebentar. Saya jalan pas reda. Kalau kamu ada di dermaga, kamu ikut.
text.en: Yanti says you sat five minutes waiting for my brother to speak. There's a lull around midday tomorrow. I go in the lull. If you're on the pier, you come.

text.id: Din. Didit tahu semester lo. Kalau dua-duanya pergi, Ibu sendirian, dan HP ini...
text.en: Din. Didit knows your semester. If we both go, your mom's alone, and this phone...

text.id: Jangan suruh gue jadi orang yang nunggu di rumah lagi, Ka.
text.en: Don't make me the one who waits at home again, Ka.

text.id: HP Sekar ada di meja di antara kalian.
text.en: Sekar's phone is on the desk between you.

text.id: "Lo pegang HP-nya. Itu bukan nunggu. Itu jagain buktinya."
text.en: "You keep the phone. That's not waiting. That's guarding the evidence."

text.id: "Gue bawa HP-nya. Kalau Sekar nelpon lagi, gue harus angkat."
text.en: "I'm taking the phone. If Sekar calls again, I have to answer."

text.id: ...Oke. Tapi lo telepon gue tiap jam. Dari HP lo sendiri.
text.en: ...Okay. But you call me every hour. From your own phone.

text.id: Pak Hendra bilang jangan. Kak Sekar bilang jangan. Lo selalu harus belajar sendiri, ya.
text.en: Pak Hendra said don't. Sekar said don't. You always have to learn things the hard way, huh.

text.id: Gue tidur di lantai kamar Sekar, dengerin angin. Jam lima pagi, gue kebangun sendiri, tanpa alarm.
text.en: I sleep on the floor of Sekar's room, listening to the wind. At five in the morning, I wake on my own, without an alarm.
